messages:
olivia: Heads up — partner shipped the rack but split the SKU between two PO lines. One set is A100-80GB (reserved) and the other is A100-80GB-REF (refurb). We only booked reservations for the first PO.
raj: Ack. Do we have packing lists?
olivia: I uploaded the vendor packing list to the drive: https://drive.redwood.example/partners/ship-1781. It shows 24 units on PO-1234, 12 units on PO-1235 (REF).
emma: That SKU split will trigger marketplace billing mismatches — reserved capacity map expects SKU tag `a100-80-resv`. The REF SKU came through as `a100-80-ref` and marketplace didn't apply committed credits. Customers hit overage charges.
lisa: Oof. Any customers already invoiced?
emma: One customer on Dedicated (acct: acme-analytics) got billed for ~48h of overage. Finance requests a credit hold until we reconcile.
tom: Marketplace team — can we retroactively map the REF SKU to the reservation family? If not, we need to update partner listing and issue credits. @tom
ops-bot: incident-created #INC-2026: "Partner SKU mismatch => billing overages" assigned to @emma, @olivia
raj: On the infra side, we can tag the REF nodes with the reserved pool label, but that requires partner cooperation (they control node metadata until we inventory). ETA to get partner to re-run inventory?
olivia: Partner POC (marco@vendor) says they can update tags but needs exact label key/value. Raj — can you paste the label?
raj: Use: `redwood.reservation_pool: a100-80-resv-v2` (case-sensitive). Partner needs to include `asset_serial` when they re-run.
lisa: Technical ask: will relabeling change host IDs and break existing allocations?
raj: No, relabel is metadata-only. We should still cordon and re-drain if host has live workloads — plan minimal disruption windows.
emma: Finance wants an interim credit for acme-analytics. Proposal: 100% credit for those 48h overages pending partner reconciliation. Approve?
olivia: +1 from partnerships. We need partner signoff on schedule and an action log.
tom: Marketplace: we'll open a marketplace update ticket to treat `a100-80-ref` as a compatible SKU for reservation families going forward. I'll also add a one-off mapping for the affected time range.
ops-bot: deploy-note: marketplace-mapping updated (internal ticket MP-442)
emma: I'll draft the credit memo and route to legal & billing. Can someone confirm the exact customer IDs and timestamps?
olivia: acme-analytics (acct-id: acct_98Y), affected window: 2026-02-17T03:00Z -> 2026-02-19T03:00Z (approx).
lisa: Recommend postmortem template: cause, mitigation, partner action, marketplace change, finance credit, next steps. I can own the doc.
olivia: Action items: 1) raj get label to partner + confirm relabel schedule (ETA EOD tomorrow) 2) tom create marketplace mapping & ticket (in progress) 3) emma issue provisional credit 4) lisa write postmortem.
raj: I'll ping Marco now.
olivia: Thanks — keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
emma: tagging billing ops to hold final invoice until reconciliation — @billing-ops
__note: No title field included per agents.md. Thread written as continuous Slack messages string.
